dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 公共施設 evacuation shelters and public facilities series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(公共施設 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 全国の官公署、学校、病院、郵便局、社会福祉施設等の位置及び種別、名称、住所、管理者等のデータを整備したものである 作成年度：平成18年度 原典資料：数値地図25000（地名・公共施設）、全国博物館総覧（（株）ぎょうせい）、日本の図書館－統計と名簿－2005年度版（（社）日本図書館協会）、平成19年度職員録（上巻・下巻）（（独）国立印刷局）... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are デジタルシティ, 国交DPF, 国土数値情報, 山梨県. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
